name: Rolled Oats
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients due to soluble fiber content that feeds beneficial bacteria without excessive fermentation.
preparationTips: Soak overnight to improve digestibility and reduce cooking time
Cook with lactose-free milk or water instead of regular dairy
Add low-FODMAP fruits like strawberries or kiwi for natural sweetness
Start with smaller portions if you have sensitive digestion
